title: The Snow Fairy - a winter tale
en: when i was a child i like to imagine that fairies brought about the change of seasons a little pixie planted spring wildflower seeds lord summersprite coaxed the sun rays over the meadow and a sweet old autumn gnome gathered the harvest and then there was the snow fairy i still think of her in particular as her image has stayed with me throughout the years i always imagine her riding a rabbit she has long curly hair and mysterious melancholy eyes he was often misunderstood by the other she was often misunderstood by the other fairies who feared her strange looks and ways so they would banish her to the highest mountain peaks when her time was over to wait in a

lonely ice cave until she could return again aturally this made the fairy feel quite naturally this made the fairy feel quite unwelcomed as she longed to visit the other seasons and discover their treasures she dreamt of wandering flower fields barefoot and tasting the crisp sweetness of fall fruit but the other fairies were uninviting fearing her frosty fingers would wither anything she touched the snow fairy was hurt and the next
time she was sent to the mountains of eternal winter to wait out the year she vowed never to return why should she no one cared no one wanted her in the land below my

sequestered in the mountains the snow fairies spent her days casting spells of frost raining snowflakes and summoning blizzards it was a beautiful world she created the landscape was a tapestry she wove with ice and crystal here where the air was thin she felt safe there were no fairies or townspeople to grumble at the snow wishing for spring to come sooner yes the fairy would stay in her mountains this would please everyone she thought

but when the cold was supposed to come to the rest of the land it didn't the open fields were untouched by snowflakes lake water unfrozen the open sky blue and cloudless that year the land suffered from lack of water and the other fairies could not fulfill

their duties the parched land was infertile something had to be done the fairies pleaded with woodland animals hoping some beast would be brave enough to scale the mountains and call back the snow fairy it is too cold for us they said we will freeze our toes and get lost in the blizzard and even if we did find her she would not listen to us we who were so cold and cruel to her and sent her away i will go and fetch her said the rabbit he was small but courageous and unafraid of snowdrifts but even the hardiest of rabbits cannot scale a mountain slope and when he finally reached the ferry he had only one breath

left in his little body he told her that the land was dying without her help and that she had to return and that he missed her dearly and with that he closed his eyes the fairy wept over the noble rabbit as she had never wet before her heart which had been safely locked away for so long broken too you may not know this but when a fairy's heart breaks the special magic is released one that can grant his single wish the fairy held the wisp of pixie dust in her palm and was tempted to wish for a winter that would come and go without her assistance she could then stay in the mountains forever away from all that caused her pain

but that was not what the fairy did because in its broken state her heart had felt love for the very first time now each year once the harvest has been gathered the snow fairy begins her long trek down from her mountain carrying a basket of snowflakes to spread over the countryside her job is difficult and there are those who still don't enjoy her visits but she no longer hears their words and now she has a friend to accompany her because if you ever catch a glimpse of the snow fairy through your window as the frost sets in on wintertide's eve you will see that a small rabbit trail
is behind her following her steps and gazing in awe at the beauty of her snowy world you
zh: 当我还是个孩子的时候，我喜欢想象仙女们带来季节的变化，一个小精灵种下春天的野花种子，夏精灵大人哄着阳光洒满草地，一个可爱的老侏儒收集收获，然后还有雪仙子，我仍然特别想起她，因为她的形象多年来一直伴随着我，我总是想象她骑着一只兔子，她有一头长长的卷发和神秘忧郁的眼睛，他经常被别人误解。被其他仙女误解，他们害怕她奇怪的外表和行为，所以当她的时间结束时，他们会把她放逐到最高的山峰上等待。
孤独的冰洞，直到她能再次自然地返回，这让仙女感觉很自然，这让仙女感到很不受欢迎，因为她渴望参观其他季节，发现他们的宝藏，她梦想赤脚漫步花田，品尝秋天果实的清脆甜味，但其他仙女不受欢迎，担心她冰冷的手指会枯萎她触摸的任何东西，雪仙子受伤了，下一个
当她被送到永恒的冬天的山里等待她发誓永远不会回来的那一年结束时，为什么她应该没有人关心没有人希望她在我下面的土地上
雪仙们隐居在山中，整天施展冰霜咒语，下雪花，召唤暴风雪，这是她创造的美丽世界，风景是她用冰和水晶编织的挂毯，这里空气稀薄，她感到很安全，没有仙女或镇民对雪发牢骚，希望春天早点到来，是的，仙女会留在她的山里，这会让她认为的每个人都高兴。
但当寒冷降临到其他地方时，空旷的田野却没有被雪花覆盖，湖水没有结冰，开阔的天空蔚蓝无云，那年大地缺水，其他仙女无法满足
他们的职责 干旱的土地贫瘠，必须做点什么 仙女们向林地动物恳求，希望有一些野兽能够勇敢地翻山越岭，把雪仙子叫回来，这对我们来说太冷了，他们说我们会冻住脚趾，在暴风雪中迷路，即使我们找到了她，她也不会听我们的，我们对她如此冷漠和残忍，把她送走了，我要去接她说，兔子他很小，但很勇敢，不害怕雪堆，但是即使是最坚强的兔子也无法爬上山坡，当他终于到达渡口时，他只剩下一口气了

留在他小小的身体里，他告诉她，如果没有她的帮助，这片土地正在死去，她必须回来，他深深地想念她，然后他闭上眼睛，仙女为这只高贵的兔子哭泣，因为她从未湿润过她的心，这颗心被安全地锁了这么久，也破碎了，你可能不知道这一点，但当仙女的心破碎时，会释放一种特殊的魔法，可以实现他的一个愿望。仙女把一缕仙尘放在手掌里，禁不住希望有一个来来去去的冬天。如果没有她的帮助，她就可以永远留在山里，远离所有给她带来痛苦的事物
但这不是仙女所做的，因为在破碎的状态下，她的心第一次感受到了爱，现在每年收获后，雪仙子开始长途跋涉，从山上背着一篮子雪花散布到乡村，她的工作很困难，有些人仍然不喜欢她的来访，但她不再听到他们的话，现在她有一个朋友陪伴她，因为如果你在冬夜霜降时透过窗户瞥见雪仙子你会看到一条小兔子踪迹
在她身后跟随她的脚步，敬畏地凝视着她冰雪世界的美丽
